— Мимо… Там мимо не ходят. Там только ко: “Passing through… Nobody passes through there. There's only digging there.” He spits at his feet. “Go on, since you're going. Just don't linger at the ashes: them as linger there get asked later — why.”
— Мой. Корм там держу. — Он даже не пыта: “Mine. Keep feed in it.” He doesn't even try to pretend it's true.
— Молчит. — Вас обыскивают быстро и груб: “Won't talk.” You are searched, quickly and roughly. There's nothing to take. “Skint. Fine, go. But next time, answer when you're asked.”
— Молчит. — Старший кивает своим. Вас об: “Won't talk.” The senior one nods to his men. You are searched, quickly and roughly. “Five shillings confiscated for the Assembly. Be grateful it weren't you. Move.”
“Keep off the scaffold. Looking's allowed. Touching — no. Cutting down — even less.”
— Нефть — достояние народа. Так на плака: “Oil belongs to the people. Says so on the poster. And so the people don't walk off with what's theirs — the brothers stand guard.” He smiles with his lips only.
— Нигде. Частная практика отменена. Кто: “Nowhere. Private practice has been abolished. Anyone fitting iron without a referral is a wrecker.” He makes a note in the register. “And why do you wish to know?”
— Никто… Никто нынче — это хорошо. Никог: “Nobody… Nobody's a good thing to be these days. Nothing to hang nobody for.” The brother smirks, but his eyes don't. “Off you go. And don't stray off the road.”
— Никто… — Офицер долго молчит. — Тогда: “Nobody…” The officer is silent for a long time. “Then go, nobody. And you never saw us.” The branches close behind them as if no one had ever been there.
— Он самый. Сильвер. Висит с того дня, к: “The very same. Silver. Been hanging since the day the fort was took. The Assembly decided — let him hang till he rots. So everyone remembers how tyranny ends.”
— Особый лагерь её светлости. Вольным —: “Her Ladyship's Special Camp. Civilians may proceed as far as the guardhouse and along the main road. Do not speak to prisoners, do not pass them anything. The towers see everything.”
— Отойди от вышки. Нефть — достояние нар: “Step away from the derrick. Oil belongs to the people. Move along, don't loiter.”
— Пайки — на площади, у раздатчицы. Без: “Rations are on the square, from the woman at the stall. No card — pay in shillings. Keep to the streets, don't go poking into yards, and after dark — under lock and key.”
“Mind you don't stand under a fallin' tree.”
— Порядок простой: все служат. Кто ловит: “Rules are simple: everyone serves. Some fish, some dig ore, some stand in the ranks. The Baroness don't abandon her own — and she expects the same of 'em.”
— Построение на плацу — на рассвете. Доб: “Parade on the drill ground — at dawn. Volunteers for the militia — report to the chancery. Breakers of the peace — to the commandant. Glory to the Baroness!”
— Приказ. Деревню Собрание осудило — зна: “Orders. The Assembly condemned that village — so it don't exist, and there's no call to go there.” The second brother glances silently at the firs. The senior one pretends not to notice. “And why else we stand here — that's none of your business.”
— Пришли братья. Сказали — мы кормили гв: “The brothers came. Said we'd fed the baron's guard. Fed 'em, aye. They was people too, hungry… Turned everyone out into the street and set the houses alight. Them as made it to the woods are alive. Them as didn't — over there, by the chapel, they're lying.”
— Проваливай. Пайки — для тех, кто служи: “Clear off. Rations are for them as serves, not for vagrants.”
— Пропуск дают тем, кто нужен наверху. Т: — Passes are issued to those required above. You are not required.
— Пропуск. — Стражник протягивает руку и: — Pass. — The guard holds out a hand and waits. — No pass? Then turn round.
— Работу… Её сейчас все ищут. В Эшфорде: “Work… Everyone's after work these days. Ida Crowe in Ashford's always calling for someone — they need hands there. And don't go loafing about the High Road with nowt to do.”
— Раз в неделю. Считают брёвна, считают: “Once a week. Count the logs, count the men. They talk to me on me own — told me not to take the gangs deep into the thicket. Didn't say why. I didn't ask.”
— Разговорчивый, а? Сид, держи его!: — Got a mouth on you, eh? Sid, grab 'im!
— С чего бы мне тебе докладывать? — Серж: “Why should I report to you?” The sergeant spits. “Fine.”
— Свобода произошла. Барона Сильвера бол: “Liberty happened. Baron Silver's no more — he's hanging in the fort, you'll see. The People's Assembly rules the land now. And them as served the old regime — we're hunting 'em.” He spits in the dust. “We'll find every last one.”
— Слово хочешь? Слово у нас дорогое. Не: “Want a word, do ye? Words come dear with us. Not in shillings — in blood. A drop of thine in the cauldron, and one word for thee. Agreed?”
“Halt! Patrol of Her Ladyship the Baroness.” A sergeant in a helmet with a red stripe looks you up and down. “A stranger. From the east, then. Papers, purpose, weapons.”
— Стой. — Брат оглядывает вас и ваш рука: “Halt.” The brother looks you over, and your sleeve. “Not one of ours. Not local. What d'you want in Liberty?”
— Стоять! Братья свободы. — Старший с кр: “Halt! Brothers of Liberty.” The senior one, a red band on his sleeve, keeps his hand on his holster; the two behind him don't lower their rifles. “In the name of the People's Assembly: who are you, where from, where to?”
— Ступай. И помни: здесь земля баронессы: “Off you go. And remember: this is the Baroness's land.”
“Off you go. And don't go flappin' your mouth round here.”
— Те, кого ваши бароны сожгли бы, если б: “Them as your barons would burn, if they dared come near. They don't dare. We were here afore the barons, and we'll be here after.” Somewhere in the fog an imp giggles.
— Те, кому велено. Работают на её светло: “Those as are ordered to be. They work for Her Ladyship — atoning. You've no need to know more.”
— Тогда нет. Протезы — для братьев свобо: “Then no. Prostheses are for Brothers of Liberty wounded in the struggle. On the commissar's referral. You are not a brother.” At last he looks up. “Or would you like to become one?”
— Форт её светлости баронессы. Добро пож: “The fort of Her Ladyship the Baroness. Welcome. Keep your weapon to yourself, stay out of fights, don't be late for parade — if you're stopping.”
— Хочешь слово? Слово у нас передают из: “Want a word, eh? Words are passed hand to hand with us, not on the parade ground. I'll show you one. Pay up — and sit till morning.”
— Чего надо? Патруль его милости барона: “What d'you want? Patrol of 'is lordship Baron Aldridge.” The sergeant raises his lantern to your face and studies it a long while. “Not from round 'ere. No papers neither, I'll wager? Who are you, where you headed?”
— Эйнбоу кормила гвардию барона, прятала: “Einbow fed the baron's guard, hid it, tended its wounded. The Assembly passed judgement.” At last he raises his eyes. “Do you object to some aspect of the Assembly's decision?”
— Эшфорд — это масло, а масло — это баро: — Ashford's oil, and oil's the Baron. This road runs straight to the Baroness. The Baron don't want her lot wandering about his oilfield.
…Передай в Бриммор, что я жива. Если пой: …Tell 'em in Brimmor I'm alive. If you're goin' that way.
